intent.summary: Places children in one shared bounds and paints later children above earlier children.
useWhen: A background, content, and adornment share bounds

semantics.childPolicy: zero or more visual children sharing a coordinate space
semantics.sizing: union of intrinsic child extents subject to parent constraints
semantics.ordering: first child is backmost; last child is frontmost

attributes.name: alignment
attributes.description: Anchor used to align each child within shared bounds.

attributes.name: clipping
attributes.description: Whether painting outside shared bounds is clipped.

accessibility.focusBehavior: container is not focusable; descendant navigation follows semantic order
notes: Paint order must not be assumed to define reading order.

mappings.strategy: Normalize modifiers and ZStack children into explicit layers.
Use Grid for aligned layers and Canvas only for explicit coordinates.
caveats: ZIndex may be required if insertion order changes.

mappings.strategy: Map through Qt Quick or Qt Widgets constructs using the same layout intent and accessibility contract.
caveats: Qt Quick and Qt Widgets differ in sizing, ownership, and event wiring.
